description: Count a cash drawer by denomination with exact integer maths (no float errors): JOD (3 decimals, fils), USD, EUR, SAR, AED, GBP, KWD, EGP, or a custom currency (your own note and coin values, 0/2/3 decimals). Give how many of each note/coin (by value like 50 or 0.25, by label like "50 JD" or "¼ dinar"); returns per-denomination amounts, the total, notes and coins counted, and over/short against an expected amount. list=true shows the denominations of a currency. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/cash-counter/

denomination.description: Value in major units (50, 0.5) or the label ("50 JD", "1 SAR coin").

kind.description: Only needed when a value exists as both a note and a coin (e.g. 1 SAR).

note.description: Optional note for the summary (e.g. "Evening shift").

name: calc_cash_count
title: Cash counter
